relationships.subject: UK4b
relationships.evidence_quote: UK4b is ~ fivefold more potent (IC50 = 33 nM) against human mPGES-1 than its inhibitory activity against mouse mPGES-1 (IC50 = 157 nM)27.

relationships.subject: UK4b
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with 10 mg/kg UK4b effectively blocked the PGE2 overproduction.

relationships.subject: UK4b
relationships.evidence_quote: Pretreatment with UK4b effectively and dose-dependently reduced the hyperalgesia (Fig. 1B) and decreased the edema (Fig. 1C).

relationships.subject: UK4b
relationships.evidence_quote: Interestingly, UK4b also significantly (and dose-dependently) attenuated both the postoperative hyperalgesia and allodynia.

relationships.subject: UK4b
relationships.evidence_quote: the treatment with 10 mg/kg UK4b did not significantly change any of the PGD2, PGF2α, PGI2, and TXA2 concentrations, while significantly blocking the PGE2 overproduction (Fig. 4A).

key_findings: Selective mPGES-1 inhibitor UK4b relieved carrageenan hyperalgesia, CFA arthritis pain and postoperative pain, outperforming oxycodone/gabapentin/morphine in some measures.
UK4b blocked PGE2 overproduction without changing other prostanoids or basal PGE2.
